reviews.title: Bait and switch
reviews.text:
So sad about this app, I paid for the lifetime version, and now they’ve made enough changes where that version isn’t available anymore. I was able to creat charts and change colors of my markers, flip designs and merge them together. I loved it, until they got my payment for a lifetime, then they made all the features only available if you pay a yearly subscription. So my PAID subscription now I get the FREE version that everyone can get, so what did I pay for??
I understand it’s the way of the world to make money, but how many people did they lie to about the lifetime version? I wouldn’t pay for this app again even if it did my knitting for me, burn me once, shame on you…I’m not getting burned again.

reviews.title: knitCompanion
reviews.text: I cannot get my patterns moved from the older app..to the newer app…I do not have Ravelry and only a few patterns were in Drop Box..they did move..all the others are just in the previous  app on my previous Ipad.

reviews.title: Awful UX
reviews.text: I found this one of the most complex apps I have ever encountered. There is nothing intuitive about it whatsoever. So many places to go and look for tutorials on their website but even there it's confusing. It should be renamed knit confusion.

reviews.title: Womp womp
reviews.text: If you are a cross stitcher wanting to use this app to mark up your digital patterns, pass on this app. I can find no way to mark a single stitch. Groups of stitches- yes. Also, the app does not accurately identify symbols. I’ve spent hours researching and trying to get it to work properly. Support and tutorials are extremely lacking.

reviews.title: Awful UX design m, better options out there
reviews.text:
The app feels clunky and unintuitive, and the overall UX design is honestly very outdated compared to what you’d expect from a paid tool today. Navigation isn’t smooth, and simple tasks take way more tapping and figuring out than they should.

For something that’s positioned as a premium knitting companion tool, it feels like it hasn’t kept up with modern app standards. There are plenty of other knitting apps out there that are easier to use, more polished, and frankly, cost less.

At this price point, I expected something much more streamlined and user-friendly. I wouldn’t recommend spending the money on this one when better options exist.

reviews.title: Deleting
reviews.text: -10 out of 10 stars. Do not recommend.

reviews.title: This Sucks
reviews.text: This is not intuitive at all. I have watched videos over and over and checked out the Knit Companion Ravelry group and googled. Every answer in Ravelry is that KC will “ open a ticket”. This is unacceptable. I would like to use magic markers feature to change colors in a chart. I am paying for the yearly subscription so this feature is in my plan. I have been trying to go this for several days to no avail. This is a WASTE OF MY MONEY.

reviews.title: Charged twice for app
reviews.text: I downloaded this app from the App Store on January 1, 2026 and was charged $32.69 then I was charged the same amount again on January 19, 2026.

reviews.title: Don’t pay for full version if you want to keep using it!
reviews.text: Just paid for full version and now it won’t do anything at all! Won’t even let me change the page on my pattern and won’t let me close the App down and can’t even restart my computer. Also doesn’t synch up from computer to phone app, if you mark something on one it doesn’t show on the other so your progress can’t be tracked. But that was when it was actually working, now it’s not doing anything at all so guess that doesn’t matter anymore.
